```
def check_depth(root):
    # iterative DFS with explicit stack of (iterator, depth)
    if not isinstance(root,(dict,list)):
        return True
    stack=[(iter(root.values() if isinstance(root,dict) else root),1)]
    while stack:
        it,d=stack[-1]
        if d>32: return False
        try:
            node=next(it)
        except StopIteration:
            stack.pop(); continue
        if isinstance(node,(dict,list)):
            if d+1>32: return False
            stack.append((iter(node.values() if isinstance(node,dict) else node), d+1))
    return True
```
